risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and includes market estimates, operating priorities, and selected quantified sensitivities, but relies substantially on forward-looking qualifiers and non-GAAP measures. Key risks include weaker demand, raw-material scarcity and volatility, restructuring and impairment charges, environmental liabilities, seasonality, and uncertainty around unforecastable GAAP adjustments.
